label: Cars
definition: Vehicles as a topic for noticing and comparing motion.
scope_notes: Use toys or hypothetical runs; no current product rankings.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Sharks
definition: Sharks as a topic for noticing how animals move, live, and eat.
scope_notes: Use pictures and hypothetical comparisons; avoid frightening framing.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Soccer
definition: Soccer as a topic for noticing pushes, directions, and fields.
scope_notes: Use a soft ball or hypothetical plays.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Distance traveled
definition: The length of a route traveled by an object.
scope_notes: Distance traveled and displacement need not be equal.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Elapsed time
definition: The duration between a chosen start and end.
scope_notes: State the start, end and unit when comparing.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Average speed
definition: Distance traveled divided by elapsed time.
scope_notes: An interval average does not describe every moment of motion.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Average acceleration
definition: Change in velocity divided by the elapsed time.
scope_notes: Velocity includes direction. A time alone is not acceleration.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Rate
definition: A quantity expressed per unit of another quantity.
scope_notes: Name both quantities and units; not every rate measures time.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Change
definition: A difference between states or measurements.
scope_notes: Specify what changed and the comparison being made.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Force
definition: A push or a pull on an object.
scope_notes: Name what pushes, what is pushed, and in which direction.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Direction
definition: Which way something points or moves.
scope_notes: Describe direction relative to something, such as toward the goal.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Friction
definition: A force that resists sliding or rolling between surfaces.
scope_notes: Friction can slow motion and also lets tires and shoes grip.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Streamlined shape
definition: A smooth shape that moves through water or air with less resistance.
scope_notes: Resistance depends on speed and shape; keep comparisons qualitative.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Comparison
definition: Examining similarities or differences using explicit criteria.
scope_notes: A useful comparison states which attributes matter.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Fair test
definition: A comparison designed to separate the factor of interest from other influences.
scope_notes: One simple comparison rarely establishes a universal cause.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Observation
definition: A recorded description or measurement of what was noticed.
scope_notes: Keep observations distinguishable from explanations and guesses.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Measurement
definition: Comparing a quantity with an agreed unit.
scope_notes: A measurement needs a quantity, value and unit.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Length
definition: The extent of something along one dimension.
scope_notes: State units and align measuring tools consistently.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Perimeter
definition: The total length around a plane figure's boundary.
scope_notes: Boundary length differs from surface area.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Area
definition: The measure of a two-dimensional region.
scope_notes: Use square units; boundary length alone does not determine area.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Square unit
definition: An area unit represented by a square with unit-length sides.
scope_notes: A unit square is a model for area, not a unit of perimeter.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Rectangle
definition: A quadrilateral with four right angles.
scope_notes: A square is a particular rectangle.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Animal body parts
definition: Structures such as fins, gills, and tails that serve functions.
scope_notes: Body parts vary by species; name the animal being discussed.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Adaptation
definition: A trait that helps a living thing survive where it lives.
scope_notes: Describe what the trait helps with; avoid saying animals chose their traits.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Habitat
definition: The place where a living thing finds what it needs.
scope_notes: Name the specific place, such as a reef or open ocean.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Food chain
definition: A sequence showing which living things eat which.
scope_notes: Real feeding relationships form webs; a chain is a simplified model.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.
